caption: Mukesh Art is bringing premium airport media planning to Rajkot International Airport. From digital screens to front-lit boards and in-terminal placements, the goal is simple: help serious brands show up in the right airport zones with the right media mix. Follow for inventory drops, campaign ideas and airport media updates.

Digital airport media works best when it follows the passenger journey. Mukesh Art's digital inventory covers check-in, SHA, gates, arrival and exit movement, giving brands repeated visibility inside the terminal instead of a single isolated screen. DM for digital screen package availability.

Airport approach media should not disappear after sunset. Front-lit boards give brands a strong static presence on terminal approach and exterior movement, with night visibility for passengers, drivers, taxis and pickup/drop traffic. Ask for front-lit board options and location photos.
